scope: Public primary sources and public offer files only. No AWS account, data-provider API or model calls.

sources.title: Twelve Data personal pricing
sources.claim: The current Grow card displays USD 79/month at 377 credits/minute.
sources.implication: Exact subscription, listing coverage and use rights remain unverified.

sources.title: Trial; dated 18 August 2026
sources.claim: The support article reports Grow 55 starting at USD 29/month.
sources.implication: Treat the lower price as conditional pending current purchase and rights confirmation.

sources.title: Claude API pricing
sources.claim: Current Haiku 5.5 short-prompt and Sonnet 5.5 rates provide illustrative bands.
sources.implication: No route model is selected; evaluate suitability and reserve eligible credit before calls.

sources.title: SageMaker AI endpoints and quotas
sources.claim: Training endpoints are listed in Virginia, Ireland and London.
sources.implication: Actual account quotas, instance availability and packaging still need proof.

sources.title: Cognito endpoints and quotas
sources.claim: User-pool endpoints are listed in all three candidate regions.
sources.implication: The required assurance feature, tier and rollout need separate proof.

sources.title: Lambda quotas
sources.claim: The Durable section explicitly names Virginia and Ireland.
sources.implication: This is service availability evidence, not account quota or runtime proof.

sources.title: Durable expansion;22 April 2026
sources.claim: The expansion includes London and states Python 3.13/3.14 support.
sources.implication: Verify the exact selected runtime, SDK and packaging before implementation.

sources.title: Cost Explorer pricing
sources.claim: Primary-view requests cost USD 0.01 each; custom views may charge per source.
sources.implication: Budget paginated collector calls; dashboard refresh reads cached totals.

sources.title: Cost Explorer guide
sources.claim: Billing refreshes at least daily; upstream data can arrive later than 24 hours.
sources.implication: Use reservations and explicit report age rather than promising realtime billing.

sources.title: CloudWatch pricing
sources.claim: Logs, metrics, recorded traces and trace queries have separate billing units.
sources.implication: Bound dimensions and price both ingestion and retrieval.

sources.title: CloudFront pay as you go pricing
sources.implication: Use UK/Europe reference prices without deducting unverified free allowances.

sources.title: CodeBuild pricing
sources.claim: The small on-demand EC 2 example uses USD 0.005/minute.
sources.implication: US reference only; regional build rate and CI selection need confirmation.

sources.title: Route 53 pricing
sources.claim: A hosted zone costs USD 0.50/month and standard queries USD 0.40/million.
sources.implication: Price two zones and registration separately.

sources.title: Cognito pricing
sources.claim: The Essentials reference is USD 0.015/MAU; messaging charges can apply.
sources.implication: No free-tier deduction; exact assurance tier remains to be proven.

sources.title: KMS pricing
sources.claim: Customer keys cost USD 1/month plus requests; rotation versions can add fees.
sources.implication: Proposed two-key baseline needs recosting for extra versions or keys.

sources.title: Athena pricing
sources.claim: SQL reference pricing is USD 5/TB, with minimum scans and adjacent S 3/catalog costs.
sources.implication: Optional reconciliation scans are capped; no always-on analytics service is assumed.

sources.title: EventBridge pricing
sources.claim: Scheduler reference pricing is USD 1/million invocations after allowances.
sources.implication: Ancillary estimate includes schedules; free allowances are not multiplied.

sources.title: SQS pricing
sources.claim: Payload size and request volume affect costs.
sources.implication: Exact queue volume and regional charges remain in the explicit ancillary estimate.

sources.title: Lambda pricing
sources.claim: Compute, requests, Durable operations/state and streaming data are separate dimensions.
sources.implication: Include active stream waiting time and resumed invocations.

cash_timing_derivation.source: model.json EST-COST-DOMAIN allowance, not a vendor invoice
cash_timing_derivation.inputs: USD15 proposed annual allowance; USD1.25 amortised comparison; existing quantities, FX/tax/card assumptions.
cash_timing_derivation.method: For ordinary-month cash subtract amortisation. For annual-domain invoice-month cash subtract amortisation and add full USD15 once. Convert once, then compare unrounded cash with owner thresholds.
cash_timing_derivation.checker: check_cash_timing.py independently derives amounts from line quantities and rates; no service calls.
cash_timing_derivation.limitations: Exact TLD, provider, purchase terms, actual invoice/due month and tax/credit settlement remain unverified. Other monthly services are assumed due monthly; any annual/prepaid payment terms require their own full due-month cash liability.
